summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. (a Dutch company) covering its interim financial statements for Q2 2026, with comparative data and segment disclosures. It includes borrowing movements, share-based payment arrangements, and fair value measurements. There is no transaction, tender offer, merger, or special situation event described. The filing is ordinary periodic reporting under the 1934 Act, not a special-situation announcement.
